_about: Where each of the 13 real bugs in tests/fixtures/nodegoat_labeled_claims.json lives in OWASP NodeGoat commit c5cb68a (line ranges checked by reading the files). Used only to SCORE runs: tests/eval_retrieval.py (was the vulnerable code shown to an agent?) and tests/score_report.py (did a kept finding cite it?). 'locations' lists every place a correct finding could reasonably cite; an 'absence' bug (a missing protection) can be cited where the protection should be. This file is never shown to an agent or to the verifier.

bugs.title: Remote code execution through unsafe evaluation of contribution amounts
Any logged-in user can read other users' retirement allocations
Open redirect on the learning-resources link
NoSQL injection in the allocations threshold filter
Cross-site scripting because template auto-escaping is disabled
Server-side request forgery in the research page
No server-side CSRF protection on state-changing forms
Session cookie lacks HttpOnly and Secure flags
Login errors reveal whether a username exists
User passwords are stored in plaintext in the database
Non-admin users can open the admin benefits page
